CITY OF LA VERNE
  DEVELOPMENT REVIEW COMMITTEE
  ACTION MINUTES

Eric Scherer, Chair  City Hall
Cody Howing, City Engineer  3660 “D” Street
Danny Wu, Public Works  La Verne, CA 91750
  (909) 596-8706
  www.cityoflaverne.org

  Tuesday, November 4, 2025 – 9:00 a.m.
  City Hall Council Chambers
  3660 “D” Street, La Verne, CA 91750

Attendance and participation at the City of La Verne Development Review Committee meetings are
welcomed and appreciated. Community engagement provides the Development Review Committee
with valuable information. Regular Meetings are held on the 1st Tuesday of every month. In
compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires a
modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the City Clerk’s
Office at (909) 596-8726 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

The Council Chambers will be open to the public at 9:00 a.m. Materials related to an item on this
agenda, submitted to the Development Review Committee after distribution of the agenda packet,
are available for public inspection at the meeting or in the Community Development Department during
normal business hours.

  1. CALL TO ORDER

  Mr. Scherer called the meeting to order at 9:01am.

  Voting members present: Eric Scherer, Cody Howing, and Danny Wu.

  Others present: Assistant Planner Valerie Chin

  2. PUBLIC COMMENT
 Development Review Committee Action Minutes – November 4, 2025
Page 2

  This is the time set aside for anyone wishing to address the Development Review
  Committee on items not listed in any other place on this agenda.

  California Law does not allow the Development Review Committee to take action in
  response to your statements at this meeting. Your concerns may be referred to
  staff or set for hearing at a later date.

  None

  3. APPROVAL OF ACTION MINUTES – September 2, 2025

  Mr. Wu made a motion to approve the minutes of the September 2nd meeting and
  Mr. Howing seconded. Motion carried by a 3-0 vote.

  4. PROJECT REVIEWS
  Note: Due to time constraints, discussion on these items will be limited to 30
  minutes each.

  PROJECT:  A REQUEST FOR A FAÇADE CHANGE AT GROCERY
  OUTLET
  CASE NO:  63-25PPR
  ADDRESS:  1504 FOOTHILL BOULEVARD
  Project Planners: Valerie Chin, Assistant Planner

  Environmental:  Categorically exempt

  Action: Tatia Griffin of MBH Architects was present at the meeting.

  Ms. Chin presented the report.

  It was moved by Mr. Howing and seconded by Mr. Wu to approve 63-25PPR with
  an added condition regarding future tenant space. Motion carried 3-0.

  5. ADJOURNMENT

  The meeting adjourned at 9:11 a.m. The next meeting of the Development Review
  Committee is scheduled to be held on December 9, 2025 at 9:00 a.m. at City Hall,
  3660 “D” Street, La Verne, CA 91750.

  Respectfully submitted,

  Natalie Hiatt, Administrative Secretary
